essence: Therefore the Śaiva scripture should be accepted as a valid means of knowledge by all.
Therefore other means of knowledge do not contradict its authoritativeness in its own sphere.
Thus their authoritativeness is indeed established by the attainable-attainer relation, as stated earlier.
Therefore its sphere is not obstructed by any other means of knowledge.
Therefore this scripture must be accepted as a valid means of knowledge.
